title: EloteSat Tamaulipas: QGIS plugin to map grain maize and sorghum from their phenology
description: QGIS plugin to map grain maize and sorghum in Tamaulipas (Mexico) from their phenology. It builds crop calendars per municipality and water regime from the SIAP Avance de Siembras y Cosechas, downloads Sentinel-2 L2A and Landsat 8/9 clipped to a study area, computes variables in windows relative to each pixel's own NDVI curve, explores groups without field data, measures separability and trains a Random Forest with field-grouped validation, compares mapped and SIAP sown areas, and produces municipal SIAP maps. Experimental. Formerly FenoSat (up to 0.4.0).
